scope: Completed Linux measurements of the original build, the clipped-window-shadow/connector-quad candidate, and the subsequent build with the window-frame shadow removed. Windows and macOS evidence will be supplied separately for consolidation.

measurement.metric: application-process SM utilization percent from nvidia-smi pmon
measurement.cache: fresh application process/profile, warm shared shader cache
measurement.clock_policy: Relative SM reductions require graphics and memory clocks within 5 percent.
measurement.missing_counter_policy: Missing values are excluded from means, never replaced with zero.

shadow_render_and_gpu_completion_diagnos.description: Isolated 2560x1440 physical-pixel frame; CPU submission plus GPU completion, not pure GPU time.

limits: Five paired runs across two sessions support the 2560x1440 SM comparisons; other sizes have three pairs in one session.
4K builds boosted to different clocks; raw activity and clocks are retained, with no attributed percentage reduction.
Hover sweeps have no per-row visual witness, so hover input-to-draw latency is not reported.
CPU/input timings include vendor monitoring. Separate clean timings were not run before wrap-up.
The dense-merge queue was interrupted on request; its partial capture is excluded.
The 144 Hz comparison was planned but not run before wrap-up. Fractional display scales were represented in connector pixel comparisons, not live performance captures.
Linux measurements do not establish Windows or macOS performance.

window_frame_shadow_removal.description: Remeasurement of the current release without the custom window-frame shadow, against both the optimized shadow-enabled release and the original release. Earlier renderer and graph optimizations are retained.
window_frame_shadow_removal.metric: application-process SM utilization percent from nvidia-smi pmon
window_frame_shadow_removal.aggregation: Activity/timing values are medians of per-run means/p95s from clock-comparable pairs. Percentage savings are medians of the individual paired ratios.

new_build.change: Remove the custom window-frame shadow, retaining renderer clipping and graph connector optimizations.

excluded_pairs.reason: GPU clocks differ by more than 5 percent

limits: Application-process SM utilization is a sampled activity percentage, not a GPU execution timer.
Percentage reductions only use pairs whose graphics and memory clocks agree within 5 percent.
Each control/workload has at least three clock-comparable pairs. This small host/workload sample does not establish Windows/macOS results.
The last original-baseline pair had mismatched clocks for hover and tabs; those phase comparisons are preserved but excluded, and a confirmation pair was run.
CPU/input timings include vendor monitoring, and hover has no per-row visual completion witness.
This repeat uses 2560x1440 at 60 Hz and 100 percent application UI scale.
